title: Canadian Commuter E-Bike Comparison
subtitle: Five commuter e-bikes you can buy in Canada for CAD $1,899-$2,699, with specs taken from each maker's own product page.
currency_note: Every price below was read from the maker's Canadian storefront in Canadian dollars (CAD). Specs were read from the maker's own product/spec pages on the date above.

products.best_for: A long, bike-feeling commute: the torque sensor and 100 Nm motor make pedalling feel assisted rather than motorised. It is the heaviest bike here, so it suits a garage or ground-floor lock-up.
products.source_note: Technical Specifications block on the product page (Samsung 50GB / LG M50LT cells, UL 2271). Price from the product's Shopify .js endpoint, CAD. Re-read 2026-10-08: CA$2,699.00 CAD, in stock, Reg. 74.5 lb (33.8 kg), 100 Nm, 320 lb (145 kg) / 290 lb rider, 15 Ah 720 Wh.

products.best_for: Short trips and stairs: Rad's lightest bike at 55 lb, with a rear rack rated 55 lb. The small 360 Wh battery is the trade-off - it is the shortest-range bike in this set.
products.source_note: Technical Specifications / Geometry blocks on the product page (UL-2271 battery). Price from the product's Shopify .js endpoint, CAD. Re-read 2026-10-08: CA$1,899.00 CAD, in stock, 55 lb (25.2 kg), 40 Nm, 300 lb (136 kg) / 275 lb rider, 10 Ah 360 Wh, Class 2.

products.best_for: Carrying-up-stairs and mixed bike/motor use: at 39 lb it is by far the lightest here, and light enough to ride with the motor off. The 374 Wh battery is the smallest, so plan short hops or charge often.
products.source_note: Key Features block and the Specification & Geometry table on the product page. Price shown as CA$2,099.00 CAD on the product page. Re-read 2026-10-08: the spec table now publishes Ebike Class 1/2/3 (default 32 km/h, adjustable 19-45) and Max Bike Load Capacity 150 kg, so those cells are no longer 'not stated'.

products.payload: 440 lb max bike load / 66 lb rack
products.best_for: The all-round daily commuter: a 750 W motor, a 730 Wh battery and the second-longest claimed range here (~129 km of pedal assist), with lights, fenders and a rear rack included. It ships as Class 2; Class 3 (28 mph) is unlocked in the app where local rules allow.
products.source_note: Specification & Geometry table on the product page. Price shown as CA$2,699.00 CAD (confirmed in the page's JSON-LD, priceCurrency CAD). Re-read 2026-10-08: Bike Weight now listed as 28 kg; 750 W / 1,100 W peak / 75 Nm, 15.2 Ah 730 Wh, 200 kg max load / 30 kg rack, PAS range 129 km; no sale price on the page.

products.motor: 500 W Bafang geared hub (750 W peak)
products.best_for: The long-haul, high-speed pick: the biggest battery here (960 Wh) and the only bike in this set that ships at Class 3, with a 45 km/h claimed top speed. Vancouver-designed, with a 5-year frame warranty. It was Out of Stock when checked.
products.source_note: Product page and its Specifications tab (motor, torque, battery, class, brakes, weight, weight capacity, warranty). Price shown as CA$2,699.00 (page JSON-LD: priceCurrency CAD). This model showed Out of Stock on the date checked.
